sources.title: On some exceptional cases in the integrability of the three-body problem
sources.qualified_use: Published monodromy/NVE theorem for the planar positive-mass Newtonian three-body problem near the parabolic Lagrange orbit, including the exact mass invariant sigma and exceptional set.

sources.title: Application of the Morales-Ramis theorem to test the non-complete integrability of the planar three-body problem
sources.qualified_use: Independent Morales-Ramis proof that the planar positive-mass three-body Hamiltonian is not completely integrable with meromorphic first integrals, using the normal variational system along the parabolic Lagrange solution.
